name: PADINI
recent: Padini 公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，净利同比大跌68.5%，并宣布派发第二次中期股息每股1.8仙。公司年度股东大会于11月25日举行，所有议案获通过。近期多名大股东及董事的持股变动申报频繁。
notable: 宣布第二次中期股息每股1.8仙，除息日为2026年12月10日，派发日为2026年12月28日。
截至2026年9月30日止季度净利同比下跌68.5%。
2026年11月25日年度股东大会所有议案获股东通过。
risks: 季度净利同比大幅下滑68.5%，分析员指出赚幅承压及线上竞争。
近期有多名大股东及董事的持股变动申报，包括EPF及主要股东。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为3.6594亿令吉，环比下降41.4%，同比下降6.7%；净亏损964.3万令吉，净利率为-2.6%，而上一季度净利率为9.7%。

recent_en: Padini reported a 68.5% year-on-year drop in net profit for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 and declared a second interim dividend of 1.8 sen per share. The company's AGM was held on 25 November with all resolutions passed. There have been frequent disclosures of changes in substantial shareholders' and directors' interests recently.
notable_en: Declared a second interim dividend of 1.8 sen per share, with ex-date on 10 December 2026 and payment date on 28 December 2026.
Net profit for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 fell 68.5% year-on-year.
All resolutions were passed by shareholders at the AGM held on 25 November 2026.
risks_en: Quarterly net profit fell sharply by 68.5% year-on-year, with analysts flagging margin pressure and online competition.
There have been recent disclosures of changes in substantial shareholders' and directors' interests, including EPF and major shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 365.94 million, down 41.4% QoQ and 6.7% YoY; net loss was MYR 9.643 million with a net margin of -2.6%, compared to a net margin of 9.7% in the previous quarter.
